description: The Pink Pony Pub is a legendary beachfront restaurant and bar in Gulf Shores, Alabama, known for its bright pink exterior, gulf-front views, and old-school coastal charm. Originally opened in the 1950s and reborn after multiple hurricanes, the Pink Pony has become a true local landmark where visitors and locals gather for shrimp baskets, raw oysters, burgers, gumbos, and Po' Boys. With a fun, lively atmosphere, full bar, frozen daiquiris, Bushwhackers, and family-friendly dining until 9 PM, the Pink Pony Pub delivers classic beach-bar vibes right on the sand, just steps from the Gulf of Mexico.
